Definition: to gleam; figuratively, to enlighten (by caution)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to admonish, warn, teach, shine, send out light, be light, be shining; 1a) (Niphal) to be taught, be admonished; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to teach, warn; 1b2) to shine, send out light (fig.)
